title: Interactive Coding: while Loop Counters
subtitle: Condition-Driven Repetition
description: Master dynamic loop conditions across 2 interactive stages!

challenges.title: Stage 1: Rocket Countdown
challenges.description: While <hlt>count > 0:</hlt> print <hlt>count</hlt> and decrement <hlt>count = count - 1</hlt>. Output <hlt>"Liftoff!"</hlt> afterwards.
challenges.starter_code:
count = 3
# Stage 1: Countdown
while count > 0:
    print(count)
    count = count - 1
print("Liftoff!")

challenges.title: Stage 2: Power Doubler
challenges.description: Start <hlt>val = 1</hlt>. While <hlt>val <= 8:</hlt> print <hlt>val</hlt> and multiply <hlt>val = val * 2</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
val = 1
# Stage 2: Exponential doubler
while val <= 8:
    print(val)
    val = val * 2
